summary: The paper 'AttentionLib: A Scalable Optimization Framework for Automated Attention Acceleration on FPGA' (DATE 2025) presents an MLIR-based framework called AttentionLib that automatically generates HLS C/C++ code for attention acceleration on FPGAs. No code availability statement or GitHub link appears anywhere in the paper. Extensive GitHub searches (repo search by name and keyword variants, code search for the exact paper title and the name 'AttentionLib', user searches by author names and emails) and web searches all failed to locate a public repository. The paper does not build on or evaluate with any specific third-party open-source designs either; it compares against Vitis HLS's automatic optimizations. I am confident no public repository exists for this paper.
